name: server-ime fixed quality corpus

scoring.denominator: all cases, including cases where the engine rejects the input
scoring.normalization: none; candidate and reference strings are compared exactly
scoring.top5: expected text appears among the first five candidates
scoring.cer: Levenshtein(top1, expected) / max(len(top1), len(expected)); whole expected length when no candidate exists
scoring.unsupported: category 'mixed' needs Latin/digit pass-through, and 'typo' needs correction; both are scored, never skipped

provenance: Authored for this project as independent reference answers. They were not used to build data/base/lexicon-v1.jsonl.
